messages:
maya: FYI I opened PR to clarify batch_window semantics for quantized model variants (cobalt-6B). Need docs, example SDK snippets, and a short note on cold-start vs steady-state latency. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821

devon: thanks. linking runtime perf notes now. do we have concrete cold-start numbers for int8 vs f16? want to avoid vague words in the card.

sara: quick numbers from the bench run yesterday (seq=512, batch_window_ms=10):
- cobalt-6b-f16 steady: ~3.2 ms/token
- cobalt-6b-int8 steady: ~2.1 ms/token
- cobalt-6b-int8 cold-start (empty kv cache): ~6.5 ms/token
these are on A100-80GB, pinned config. counts include tokenization. caveat: embeddings path differs. :info:

eli: ok, two doc things to cover in the PR:
1) explicit YAML/SDK snippets for setting batching/batch_window. show safe defaults.
2) a short compatibility bullet: "int8 variants disable cross-attn kv caching for sequences > 4096 and will fall back to f16" (or similar).

maya: suggested SDK snippet in the PR — feel free to copy/tweak:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = client.generate(
    model="cobalt-6b-int8",
    prompt="Summarize: ...",
    batching={"batch_window_ms": 10, "max_batch_tokens": 2048},
)
print(resp.text)
```

alex: small link nit: in the model card we currently point to internal bench report. replace with public benchmark gist: https://gist.github.com/rw-inference/cobalt6b-bench. also tweak the unit from "tokens/sec" to "ms/token" for readability.

devon: noted. sara, can you paste the raw bench command you used? I'll add it to the PR so people can reproduce.

sara: sure — run like this locally on A100: 

```bash
python bench/run_throughput.py --model cobalt-6b-int8 --seq 512 --batch_window_ms 10 --trials 20
```

also add this note under "Known quirks": "When serving > 4096 context with int8, runtime will transparently route to cobalt-6b-f16 to preserve kv cache behavior; expect additional memory and slight latency increase."

eli: for migration guide, include a checklist:
- Try batch_window_ms=10 first.
- If you see high cold-starts, enable prefix caching or warmup calls.
- For streaming apps, prefer batch_window_ms <= 5 to reduce first-token latency.

maya: docs-bot checklist?

docs-bot: checklist: [x] snippet added, [ ] bench links replaced, [ ] compatibility bullet reviewed by runtime, [ ] docs copyedit. Please mark when done.

alex: I'll open a tiny follow-up PR to change unit labels after this merges. keeping the main PR focused. :thumbsup:

devon: runtime reviewed and approved the compat bullet via DM. good to merge once bench link and snippet are in.

maya: awesome — I'll update the PR with the gist link and Eli's migration checklist. planning to merge tomorrow morning if no objections.

eli: happy to proofread before merge.

maya: thanks everyone. merging tomorrow AM unless someone flags anything urgent. :rocket:
